_comment: Known, documented divergences between repo spec surfaces and upstream drops. Every entry MUST have a matching row in the AGENTS.md Pipeline Deviations table. check_source_sync --expect-deviations passes when the only deltas are these.

brookfield.Docs/7_QC_Spec_Doc1.json: Upstream ships KeyStone-mislabeled universe prose (v3 = Keystone Mortgage, Mortgage_Base_Universe paths, keystonemortgage.com example). Repo keeps the flavor-corrected Brookfield copy; all scoring rules are upstream-verbatim.
brookfield.Guide/How_To_Use_This_Eval.md: Upstream directory-tree comment lists KeyStone-era data dirs (mortgage LOS, Stripe). Repo corrects the one line to Brookfield's actual Data/ layout.

_anti_rot_rule: Four states for every deviation entry, after the Debian empty-diff rule. (1) our side and upstream both match the recorded hashes -> deviation is LIVE and intentional, pass silently. (2) our side changed -> FAIL, accidental local drift. (3) upstream changed -> FAIL and RE-ADJUDICATE, because the justification was written against the old upstream text. (4) both sides are now identical -> the deviation is OBSOLETE, DELETE the entry. State 4 is the one manifests almost always miss, and it is why deviation files rot.

harmonygames._state_field: one of: unresolved | permanent | pending-upstream | incidental (DEP-3 'Forwarded' semantics; 'permanent' == DEP-3 'Forwarded: not-needed', a deliberate local divergence never sent upstream)
harmonygames._update_mechanism: Static  (README.chromium enum: Autoroll | Manual | Static | Static.HardFork). Vendored from a one-off drop; no autoroller exists.

HG-U2.detail: Guide_harmonygames and Evals_harmonygames cite QC_Passed/Task5_Leonard_Hayes_Source_IP_Provenance_HG from 9 files, including mandatory conditional pre-reads and the sole BATCH/BIND[] exemplar. The directory does not exist anywhere in the drop. Pinned, never aliased to another task.

HG-U3.detail: Every shipped task hardcodes a stale 'MCP_Eval_V2_HarmonyGames/' base path. universe_data_source.py resolves the base path from the registry and uses the embedded string only to detect that a pointer is present.

HG-U5.detail: Corpus is 10 tasks in a 4/4/2/0 split with QC_False_Fails_PT_Dispute_Accepted legitimately empty, against qc_verdict.py's previously documented '16/16 required'. selftest now reports N/N rather than asserting 16.

HG-U6.detail: 80 criteria against the project's 60-rubric cap, on a task upstream QC PASSED. Authority for flagging it anyway is an explicit operator ruling, not the upstream spec.

HG-U7.detail: Spec defines category as a 4-value enum (Outcome 1.1/1.2/2.1, Process). A census of all 10 shipped tasks found 372 criteria, ALL lowercase outcome/process, ZERO using the enum, including 4 QC-PASSED tasks. Enforcing the spec enum alone would fail every shipped task on a BINARY sub-dimension, so the registry accepts both forms.

HG-U8.detail: No date-stamped amendment markers anywhere (Brookfield's spec is dense with 05/05, 05/22, 06/09). AGENTS.md rule 25's 'later-dated entry wins' tiebreaker is inert for this universe.

HG-U9.detail: Contamination sweep found exactly one hit, 'Northstar Games', a games-industry entity in a worked example, NOT Brookfield's northstar_legal. Docs 13_QC_Companion.md, contaminated at the same file number in the StarPM drop, is CLEAN here. No action.

HG-U10.detail: All six evals run 15-27% longer than Evals_starpm (0:+56 1:+97 2:+141 3:+176 4:+93 5:+118 lines) and 11_Taxonomy.md is 159 lines vs StarPM's 799. F1-F6 submission-gate family NAMES match V4 but trigger conditions do NOT transfer; hg_f1_f6 must be authored from HG's own eval.

HG-U11.detail: MALFORMED JSON: parse error at line 5 column 44. Shipped this way upstream. Found during the category census; the task is otherwise classifiable from 9_QC_Feedback.txt.

HG-U12.detail: Two 0-byte QC_Feedback_Verdict.txt files. qc_verdict.py now falls back to the raw auditor form in 9_QC_Feedback.txt, deriving the score as the MINIMUM across per-dimension scores.

HG-U13.detail: MISSING_IN_REPO by design. Services_Data is 5.6 GB / ~314k files including a 223 MB JSON and four nested git packs, against a 2.5 GB repo; GitHub rejects files over 100 MB and nested .git become broken gitlinks. It is gitignored behind HarmonyGames_Base_Universe/Services_Data/README_HYDRATE.md, which records the source path, byte size, file count and a sha256 of Base_Universe_Complete_Data.json so a stale hydrate is detectable. check_source_sync reports these paths as MISSING_IN_REPO; that is the intended state, not drift. HarmonyGames inverts the usual boundary: its per-task 3_UniverseDataForThisTask.json is a ~721-byte POINTER, so Services_Data IS the source of truth and cannot simply be deleted.
